metrics.profile_summary: Versatile creative professional with over 15 years of experience in graphic design, digital marketing, and brand identity. Expert in ATL/BTL advertising and social media management across UAE and Pakistan markets.

experience.description: Leads design, brand identity, and digital print. Manages social media campaigns and improves website visibility through SEO, email, and SMS marketing.
Handled design and content marketing activities, web editing, and social media campaign management.
Conceptualized product designs and created promotional materials for digital and print branding.

experience.company: The Kidz Factory Entertainment, Abu Dhabi
experience.description: Managed event activities, online/offline branding, and social media marketing.
Developed marketing programs including brochures and newsletters; managed social media and website updates.
Focused on online/offline branding and client communication.
Managed design and web marketing teams and oversaw shopping cart website administration.
Executed on-page keyword optimization and provided live support to international clients.
Designed ATM and loyalty cards and maintained client databases.

strengths: Extensive creative and graphic design expertise
Long history of digital marketing implementation
weaknesses: No mention of GA4 or ad platform reporting
Lacks evidence of budget ownership and ROI/CAC/LTV tracking
Experience is focused on creative execution rather than strategic marketing management
No clear track record of managing integrated paid campaigns
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled Creative/Digital Designer but lacks the strategic, analytical, and budgetary management experience required for a Marketing Manager role.
